archetypes.name: dyn-composite-routing
archetypes.rationale: Composite verbs now own NEXT_ACTION routing across checks, commit, and resume legs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new implement_dispatch composite verbs for stdout envelope ownership. Focus on duplicate or missing NEXT_ACTION records, commit-route child COMMIT_ROUTE_OUTCOME parsing, and checks-step5-resume resume-output relay semantics. Verify timeout and seed-failed branches fail closed as the Skill prose expects. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-timeout-process-groups
archetypes.rationale: Per-leg timeouts now kill child process groups before routing continues.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect _run_leg_with_timeout and its callers for process-group timeout behavior. Check that timeouts kill nested descendants, preserve partial stdout where needed, and do not let commit or resume legs start after checks failure. Pay attention to platform assumptions around os.killpg and subprocess TimeoutExpired output. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
